## Checklist

- [ ] The skill lives in `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` and follows the template.
- [ ] I actually ran the steps and they work.
- [ ] The front matter states the MLatom version I tested with.
- [ ] It uses only publicly available software (no private/unpublished tools, credentials, or internal infrastructure).
- [ ] If it comes from a publication, the **Cite** section lists the paper.
